def ring_plus(fr):
    ring=None; plus=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        if n['color']=='G' and n['pixels']>=15 and min(rs)<30:
            ring=(min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
        if n['color']=='g' and min(rs)>10:
            plus.append((min(rs),min(cs)))
    return ring, sorted(plus)

def ring_plus(fr):
    ring=None; plus=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        if n['color']=='G' and n['pixels']>=15 and min(rs)<30:
            ring=(min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
        if n['color']=='g' and min(rs)>10:
            plus.append((min(rs),min(cs)))
    return ring, sorted(plus)
